theme: An open Sunday in coastal Maine.
greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan — a genuinely open Sunday in Maine with the girls at Jen's. A couple of threads are worth closing before the week starts: Eugenia is waiting on a call time, and Mike's surgery prep is coming due.

needsAttention.title: Pick a call time with Eugenia
needsAttention.detail: On the PRI thread she offered slots and is waiting for you to choose — one is Monday 12-2 PM your time, which is tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Mike's pre-op details
needsAttention.detail: Mike's oral surgery is Thursday in Portland; the prep task in Personal Tasks has pre-op instructions due tomorrow and a driver and insurance check due Tuesday. Overdue since Aug 14.

flagged.title: Interview email asks for work authorization
flagged.detail: A message about an SVP Global Public Policy role asks you to confirm visa and sponsorship status through a link - worth verifying the sender is legitimate before responding.

flagged.title: Talkiatry follow-up Tuesday
flagged.detail: Virtual visit with Dr. Snowden on Tuesday, Aug 18 at 10:00 AM ET.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley proxy notice
flagged.detail: Proxy voting material arrived for one of your private-markets holdings.

inbox.noise: The usual Sunday reading - NYT Cooking, The New Yorker, WSJ - plus your own Japanese lesson.

recipe.title: Olive oil–poached zucchini & raw tomatoes
recipe.why: Peak-summer zucchini and just-picked tomatoes, softened slowly in good olive oil — exactly the unhurried supper a quiet Maine evening is asking for.

acts.line: The calendar is empty top to bottom - a rare fully open Sunday.
Coastal Maine, the girls with Jen, the day entirely your own.
Nothing scheduled tonight, and tomorrow opens just as clear.
